fusions.name: Gnawing Flurry
fusions.desc: A flurry of gnawing bites that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Cloud Stripping
fusions.desc: A cloud of grit-laden locusts sweeps around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Dust Plague
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 14 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 4 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 3 health.

fusions.name: Fed by the Fallen
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
